title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(會澤康治研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Aizawa Koji)
keywords: Laser induced shock wave 2.Underwater shock wave 3.Sensing & visualization 4.Shock wave application 5.Regional collaboration
educationalGoal: We will grow the creativity-rich engineers with some ability such as problem finding , solving, and application through an educational program that places emphasis on basic knowledge and skills in the field of electrical and electronic engineering. The aim of this course is to help students acquire an engineering sense such as ability to analyze experimental results, theoretical thinking ability and communication ability.
advice: Each student has a project theme and works alone or in groups. A seminar will be held weekly, and the progress will be reported in the weekly paper. Students should acquire the licenses and qualifications for activities if necessary. The annual schedule is as follows. [Previous semester] Students review the project themes and project proposals defined in the preparatory seminar, and carry out the project according to the action plan. Students will also present the results of the project at an interim presentation after the end of the previous semester. [Second semester] Students carry out the project while reviewing the project proposal. In addition, students will compile the results in a project report by the end of December and prepare a presentation at the design project III (PDIII) public presentation examination committee at the end of the semester. The contents of the ongoing project will be handed over to students in the next fiscal year. The project theme is decided by consultation with professor. This seminar is the final of the project design process. Students should review basic subjects and acquire advanced specialized knowledge through experiment and theory examination of the project. To pass, students must earn at least 60% out of 100%.
books: Textbooks:Specified from professor of this seminar if necessary. Reference books:Specified from professor of this seminar if necessary. Reserved books:Specified from professor of this seminar if necessary.
requiredKnowledge: Not only basic knowledge about electrical circuits, electromagnetism, electrical materials, physical property, and programming, but also a high degree of mathematical knowledge to explain physical phenomena is often required.

activityGoals.body: Be able to build research plans by clarifying the purpose of the project.
Be able to embody the problem of project and its solution and execute it safely and continuously.
Be able to correctly analyze and evaluate research results.
Be able to effectively present research results in group discussions.
Be able to summarize the research results as a project report.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students can explain the contents of the project through completely understanding of the meaning and purpose, and can also point out the problem of the project. Students can propose more research results. Students must design and manufacture the equipment needed for the project. Students can present the research results of project not only at the PD III public presentation examination, but also at academic conferences. Students can satisfactory answer to the questions at the examination. Students can go through the entire research activity according to the action plan.
achievementLevels.standard: Students can explain the contents of the project through understanding of the meaning and purpose, and can also point out the problem of the project. Students can propose a research result. Students must design and manufacture the equipment needed for the project. Students can present the research results of project at the PD III public presentation examination. Students can answer to the questions at the examination. Students can go through the research activity according to the action plan.
